title: Q3 Adaptive Reservation Windows + Surge Governance Pilot
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Run a cross-functional pilot to evaluate an adaptive reservation window and surge governance model that smooths dedicated pool allocations, reduces cold-start tail latency, and preserves predictable economics for customers. The pilot should produce a repeatable rollout playbook and dashboard surfaces for Console teams.
background: Customers and SRE teams have repeatedly asked for smoother transitions between reserved capacity and burst pools. Current autoscale behavior causes either wasted reserved capacity during low traffic or sudden latency spikes during surge events. We will experiment with an adaptive reservation window (time-and-pattern-aware prewarm + soft-reserve resizing) plus governance rules to limit cost exposure during unbounded bursts.
objectives: Reduce P95 tail latency regressions during surge events compared to baseline autoscale behavior
Limit monthly cost delta for pilot customers to < 10% while improving availability
Produce a documented rollout playbook with canary criteria, rollback triggers, and Console dashboards
Validate API/contract changes for Dedicated customers and provide clear opt-in toggles
success_metrics: P95 latency for reserved-pool-backed endpoints: no more than +5% vs baseline during controlled surge experiments
Cold-start rate (requests served from cold GPU) reduced by >= 30% for pilot workloads
Token cost delta for pilot tenants: <= +10% month-over-month while meeting latency SLOs
Canary pass rate: 3 consecutive stabilization windows with no SLO breaches
Console adoption: Pilot customers can view per-route prewarm ratio and surge exposure in the UI
milestones: M1 (2026-03-01 to 2026-03-14): Design + safety review — finalize governance rules and metrics
M2 (2026-03-15 to 2026-04-12): Runtime prototype — adaptive prewarm + soft-reserve resizing implementation
M3 (2026-04-13 to 2026-05-10): Canary run with 2 pilot customers and synthetic surge scenarios
M4 (2026-05-11 to 2026-05-31): Data analysis + cost trade-off tuning
M5 (2026-06-01 to 2026-06-20): Console instrumentation and playbook authoring
M6 (2026-06-21 to 2026-06-30): Decision gate and either expand rollout or iterate
acceptance_criteria: Runtime implements adaptive reservation window with configurable lookback and aggressiveness parameters
Console surfaces per-tenant prewarm ratio and estimated surge exposure with daily and hourly granularity
Canary run shows no more than +5% P95 latency regression and meets cost cap for pilot tenants
Playbook contains explicit rollback triggers, incident runbook, and stakeholder on-call rotations
Legal/Security sign-off received for telemetry collection used by adaptive heuristics
tasks: PM: finalize list of pilot tenants and communicate SLO/price guardrails
Eng (Runtime): implement soft-reserve resizing circuit and prewarm heuristics
Eng (Infra): add tracing hooks and cost attribution labels for per-request routing
Console: design UI tiles for prewarm ratio, surge exposure, and canary status
SRE: author canary scenario scripts and failure injection plan
Analytics: create dashboards (latency, cold-start rate, token-cost delta) and automated weekly reports
